verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe an official 'Bazaar MCP server' letting MCP-compatible agents discover payment-gated x402 services via tool calls, which is a genuine first-party MCP server integration for the agentic discovery flow. However, the MCP server appears scoped to discovery only (finding payable resources), not the full pay/settle transaction flow, and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of the MCP server itself (only docs mention it). Missing for 10: evidence that payment execution (not just discovery) can be driven through the MCP server, and independent/community verification of the MCP server working end-to-end.
